overall.status: Provisional editorial assessment; not an owner-assigned grade or calculated average.

areas.assessment: Kion’s subjective assessment of the launch-experience updates on 2026-10-10 (revision 30700f02): the shared Rappy icon, minimal fan-remake notice and quieter cached startup bring the experience to A. This records the owner’s review of the updates, not a completed exported-device playtest.
areas.next: Maintain the current presentation and finish exported-device verification. A startup movie is an optional path toward S; Kion is not prioritizing that level of polish.

areas.assessment: Kion rates asset sync A following the launch and verified-cache improvements in PR #744 (merged revision d170622d). This records the owner’s assessment; exported-device verification remains a follow-up.
areas.next: Playtest the verified-cache fast path, first download and retry recovery on real devices; confirm repeat launches do not flash the patch screen.

areas.label: score:free-roam

areas.assessment: Partially implemented: bear/needle and placeable trap textures render incorrectly; player and field traps need timing, radius and status validation. Free-roam layouts and trap visibility also remain incomplete.
areas.next: Fix materials; validate arming, timing, radius and status payloads for player/field traps; verify authored layout placement. Ensure CAST trap visibility and a usable Trap Vision item that lets non-CASTs see and target traps. Playtest the material, reveal/disarm and status-delivery batch; exact fuse timing, hostile radii, confusion and authored placements remain open. Grade and owner assessment unchanged; Mac playtest pending.
areas.label: score:traps

areas.assessment: Mostly placeholders and deliberately deferred. Recover original behavior from psz-re where possible, while separating deliberate new encounter design from fidelity work.
areas.next: Add Snowfield and Makara bosses; make Mother Brain the Arca Plant boss (including necessary level changes), Dark Falz the Dark Shrine boss with a richer form progression, and Blade/Force/Shot Mother Eternal Tower bosses rather than ordinary enemies. Resolve internal identity mappings before implementation. Playtest Reyburn HUD, dodge/pushback, recovery, projectile cleanup and return/retry handling; original attack/phase fidelity and the other boss assignments remain open. Grade and owner assessment unchanged; Mac playtest pending.
areas.label: score:bosses

areas.assessment: Basic mechanics exist; lock-on and better enemy behavior are still needed.
areas.next: Specify lock-on, validate enemy families and review attack rhythm, hit alignment and recovery in play.
areas.label: score:combat

areas.assessment: Very weak in current play: Kion reports level-1 hits around 100 damage and routine one-shots, with no meaningful player or enemy-level progression. Damage, statuses, weapon specials and grinding have been deferred.
areas.next: Establish a meaningful level-1 baseline, player growth and quest/free-roam enemy levels. Design a western-punk weapon economy around crafted iron weapons and restored ancient photon weapons; then validate damage, grinding and special/status effects. Playtest Scape Doll recovery, Resta/Anti and inventory order after a hard restart alongside the existing progression/economy work. Grade and owner assessment unchanged; Mac playtest pending.
